notes: Use PowerShell hashtable -> ConvertTo-Json; do not hand-write JSON for multiline content.
Use project_path for the project root. Prefer relative file_path/path inside that root.
For write_fix, write_fix_html, and write_new_file, use content_encoding='base64' when content has newlines, quotes, backslashes, HTML, JS, or large blocks.
Read schema with GET http://localhost:8083/api/tools if a field is unclear.
known_gotchas: FILE_CHANGED_OUTSIDE_ORCHESTRATOR: read_file_range + force_reseed + retry; never refresh_project_map on [A:P]
SYNTAX_ERROR_PRE_WRITE or VALIDATION_FAILED_AUTO_REVERT: use draft_id/failed_parts and write_draft_patch; do not retry the original range blindly
A may auto-ship only after the draft is clean; it must not invent replacement content for ambiguous line drift
ca_guidance.recommended_prompt_rule: Always read_file_range first; use base64 for non-trivial content; on SYNTAX_ERROR_PRE_WRITE use draft_id/failed_parts and never retry a stale range blindly

see_also.write_transaction: Multi-hunk same file (sort ops bottom-up to avoid line shift)
see_also.search_code: If you don't know line numbers, find anchor with search_code(mode='literal') first
see_also.read_file_range: Always read target range BEFORE write_fix to confirm content
